title: Help with attack animations and movement options

posts.author: Mr_Weegee_
posts.body: So I'm using RM2k3 and I have a custom animation for the player character's basic attack. I want the animation to play when the character is in front of the enemy, not standing far away from it. I have the attack animation set to "Move to Enemy" so that I can achieve this. However, the way the character just slides over looks silly, and I wish I could make him fade out in place then fade back in when he is in front of the enemy. How would I be able to achieve this? I tried to set his moving animation to fade him out and back in, but you can always see him sliding to the enemy before fully fading, no matter how fast i make the animation. An example of what I would want is how the main character attacks in the game Grimm's Hollow, which is also made on RM2k3. So I know it's possible to do somehow...

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: Did you try opening Grimm's Hollow in RPG Maker 2003 to see how they did it? (Or is it packed with some "protector" tool?)
